description: Main activity class for managing app shortcuts, including adding, enabling/disabling, and removing shortcuts, with UI components and shortcut handling logic.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, handling shortcut management UI and interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, restores shortcuts, and sets up adapter.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the shortcut list when activity resumes.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles add button press to initiate adding a new shortcut.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Displays dialog to input website URL and reports shortcut usage.

methods.name: addUriAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new website shortcut and refreshes list.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for enable/disable and remove buttons.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string describing shortcut type/status.
